title: VR Adventure Zone
description: Immerse yourself in stunning virtual reality worlds. Experience everything from underwater exploration to space adventures. Multiple VR stations with a variety of experiences suitable for all ages.

title: Flight Simulator Experience
description: Take control of a realistic flight simulator and learn the basics of piloting an aircraft. Experience takeoffs, landings, and aerial maneuvers with guidance from experienced flight instructors.

title: Racing Simulator
description: Feel the thrill of professional racing with our high-end racing simulator featuring force feedback steering wheels, pedals, and realistic physics. Race on famous tracks from around the world.

title: Prize Claw Machine
description: Test your skills at our high-tech claw machine! Win prizes including tech gadgets, plush toys, and gift cards. Features LED lighting and modern controls for the ultimate arcade experience.

title: HPD Keiki Safety Zone
description: Learn important safety lessons from Honolulu's finest! Interactive demonstrations on stranger danger, bike safety, and emergency preparedness. Kids can explore a police vehicle and meet officers.

title: Hawaii Jobs & Career Fair
description: Explore career opportunities in Hawaii's growing tech sector. Meet with local companies, learn about internship programs, and discover what skills are in demand. Great for students and career changers.

title: HPU Innovation Showcase
description: Discover cutting-edge student and faculty projects from HPU's Computer Science and Engineering programs. See robotics demonstrations, app prototypes, and research presentations.

title: 360° Photo Experience
description: Create amazing slow-motion 360-degree videos! Our high-tech camera rig captures you from all angles in stunning detail. Perfect for social media content. Digital copies provided via QR code.

title: Laser Cutting Demonstration
description: Watch live laser cutting demonstrations and see how modern manufacturing technology works. Learn about design software, material selection, and take home a free laser-cut bookmark!
ageRestriction: All ages, supervision for young children

title: Robotics Challenge
description: Try your hand at controlling competition robots! Learn about programming, engineering, and teamwork from our award-winning robotics team. Challenge yourself to complete obstacle courses.

title: AI & Coding Workshop
description: Create your first mobile app or explore artificial intelligence in this hands-on workshop. Learn the basics of coding with visual programming tools designed for beginners. Laptops provided.
